meta.title: RFQ: the vendor revokes its bid while bidding is on
gaps: Directly assert that the revoked bid is excluded from ranking in Master QCS
Directly assert that the revoked bid cannot be awarded
warnings: go_to master_qcs → open_master_qcs — a domain step owns that screen
go_to master_qcs → open_master_qcs — a domain step owns that screen
can only test part of this — no step for: Directly assert that the revoked bid is excluded from ranking in Master QCS; Directly assert that the revoked bid cannot be awarded

steps.note: Open the existing live RFQ with the vendor bid so the buyer session remains associated with the event.
Move to the separate supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the live RFQ's pricing round where the vendor's submitted bid can be revoked.
Initiate revocation of the vendor's submitted bid.
Confirm the revoke action in the vendor portal.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the bid as revoked.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Open Responses to inspect the buyer's view of the revoked bid.
Assert that the buyer's Responses view marks the bid as revoked.
Open Master QCS to inspect the revoked bid's buyer-side comparison state.
Assert that the revoked bid remains visibly identified in Master QCS, where available.
Open the Order Activity drawer for the event.
Assert that Order Activity contains a visible record of the revocation.
